name: Queen's Vengeance
description:
<style="Inline_Underline">Each Round:</style> There is a {effect_group=1:trigger_chance} chance to apply <style="Inline_Buff">Reflect</style> to self for 1 round. If successfully applied,  <style="Inline_Buff">Reflect</style> each <style="Inline_Attack">Basic Attack</style> dealt against Meleys this round. Additionally, apply 1 stack of Laceration to the enemy dragon with the highest <style="Inline_Dragon_Speed">Initiative</style>. 

<style="Inline_Buff">Reflect</style> causes each instance of a <style="Inline_Attack">Basic Attack</style> against the target to be split between the original target and the source of the attack. Each target's mitigation stats will affect the final damage they take.

name: Battle Guile

name: The Red Queen
description: <style="Inline_Underline">Round 3,6,9:</style> Deal <style="Inline_Damage_Physical">Physical</style> Damage (Damage Rate: {effect_group=3:effect=1:base_mod}) to {effect_group=3:number_of_targets} {effect_group=3:target_type} {effect_group=3:target_range}. name: New Moon
description:
<style="Inline_Underline">Rounds 1, 3, 5</style>: {effect_group=1:trigger_chance} chance to gain 1 stack of <style="Inline_Buff">Rising Tide</style>. Double this chance ({effect_group=2:trigger_chance}) if any ally has <style="Inline_Buff">Advantage</style>.

<style="Inline_Underline">Odd-numbered Rounds</style>: Increase the <style="Inline_Dragon_Instinct">Instinct</style> (enhanced by <style="Inline_Dragon_Speed">Initiative</style>) by {effect_group=3:effect=1:base_mod} and the <style="Inline_Damage_Tactical">Tactical</style> Damage Dealt by {effect_group=3:effect=2:base_mod} of {effect_group=3:number_of_targets} {effect_group=3:target_type} <style="Inline_Breed_Sentinel">Sentinel</style> for {effect_group=3:duration_rounds} round(s).

If you have <style="Inline_Bold">4+ stacks of <style="Inline_Buff">Rising Tide</style></style>, increase these effects by 1.5x, ({effect_group=4:effect=1:base_mod} <style="Inline_Dragon_Instinct">Instinct</style> and {effect_group=4:effect=2:base_mod} <style="Inline_Damage_Tactical">Tactical</style> Damage Dealt).

name: Reactive Instincts
description: <u>Start of Combat</u>: Increase <style="Inline_Dragon_Instinct">Instinct</style> by {effect_group=1:effect=1:base_mod} and <style="Inline_Dragon_Speed">Initiative</style> by {effect_group=1:effect=2:base_mod} of the Ally with the highest <style="Inline_Dragon_Instinct">Instinct</style> until the end of combat. Both effects are enhanced by <style="Inline_Dragon_Strength">Strength</style>.

name: Full Moon
description: Rounds 6, 8, 10: {effect_group=1:trigger_chance} chance to gain 1 stack of Rising Tide. Double this chance ({effect_group=2:trigger_chance}) if any Ally has Advantage. Additionally, gain 1 stack if you have the least troops of all combatants. Crescent Blade gains: Increase the Physical Damage dealt to {ability=ability_command_legendary_crescentblade_01:effect_group=3:effect=1:base_mod}. Additionally, double this damage ({ability=ability_command_legendary_crescentblade_01:effect_group=4:effect=1:base_mod}) when you have 4+ stacks of Rising Tide.

name: Blood Moon
description:
<style="Inline_Underline">Each Round</style>: If you have <style="Inline_Bold">4+ stacks of <style="Inline_Buff">Rising Tide</style></style>, increase your <style="Inline_Damage_Physical">Physical</style> Damage Dealt by {effect_group=1:effect=1:base_mod} until the end of the round.

<style="Inline_Underline">Odd-numbered Rounds</style>: {effect_group=2:trigger_chance} chance to afflict <style="Inline_Damage_Physical">Bleed</style> on {effect_group=2:number_of_targets} {effect_group=2:target_type} {effect_group=2:target_range} for {effect_group=2:duration_rounds} round(s). Double this chance ({effect_group=3:trigger_chance}) if you have <style="Inline_Buff">6+ stacks of <style="Inline_Buff">Rising Tide</style></style>.

name: Eclipsing Strike
description: <style="Inline_Underline">Each Round</style>: {effect_group=1:trigger_chance} chance to reduce the Damage Dealt of the Enemy with the <style="Inline_Bold">Most Troops</style> by {effect_group=1:effect=1:base_mod} for {effect_group=1:duration_rounds} round(s). If you have <style="Inline_Bold">6+ stacks of <style="Inline_Buff">Rising Tide</style></style>, double this chance ({effect_group=2:trigger_chance}) and also reduce the target's <style="Inline_Dragon_Speed">Initiative</style> by {effect_group=2:effect=2:base_mod} (enhanced by <style="Inline_Dragon_Speed">Initiative</style>).
